scope: Thin local prepare code and metadata freeze only; not an actual scan, pack, restore, publication or model-result acceptance.
limits: Old unsuccessful candidates and test construction errors remain preserved; no model experiment was rerun for this preparation fix.
A failed seal may leave a scanner-stage manifest with safe_to_stage=true. Acceptance requires a complete reviewed lock and successful final return, not that intermediate flag.
The original runtime validation manifest is intentionally retained; no runtime environment, checkpoint payload or private key is in scope.
The mutable controller events file is excluded; only the exact immutable stop prefix is included.
